jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you!

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:

As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment.

• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.

• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Responsibilities:   

 
•  
You support the development, optimization and management of technical products and solutions.

•  
You work closely with customers and translate their needs into technical solutions.

Join a prestigious international law firm as a Legal Assistant supporting a Partner, two Counsel, and several Associates within the Antitrust practice. This is a long-term opportunity for an experienced legal support professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys being a key contributor to a high-performing legal team.

 

Client Details

Our client is a globally renowned law firm with an outstanding reputation across the UK, the US, and international markets. With offices located worldwide, the firm advises leading multinational organizations on complex legal matters across various industries.

Due to continued growth of the Brussels office and an upcoming move to larger premises early next year, the firm is looking to strengthen its support team with an additional Legal Assistant. You will join a collaborative environment and work closely with another experienced Legal Assistant in a duo setup, ensuring seamless support to the legal team.

 

Description

This position is primarily focused on legal administration and billing support (approximately 90% of the role), with a smaller reception component (approximately 10%).

Legal & Administrative Support

• Manage complex billing processes and prepare client invoices with a high level of accuracy.
• Follow up on billing queries and liaise with lawyers and finance teams when needed.
• Prepare, format, proofread, and finalize legal documents, presentations, and correspondence.
• Manage agendas, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments.
• Organize travel arrangements and business itineraries.
• Handle document management and maintain electronic filing systems.
• Open new client matters and support conflict check processes.
• Monitor deadlines and assist lawyers with day-to-day administrative requirements.
• Provide support to a Partner, two Counsel, and several Associates within the Antitrust practice.

Reception Support (10%)

• Welcome visitors and clients in a professional and courteous manner.
• Answer and redirect incoming calls when required.
• Support the office with occasional front-desk coverage alongside the wider administrative team.

 

• Previous experience as a Legal Assistant, Practice Assistant, Legal Secretary, or similar support position within a law firm is essential.
• Proven experience managing legal billing and invoicing processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
• Near-native level of English is mandatory.
• Good working knowledge of either French or Dutch (minimum B1 level).
• Comfortable supporting senior legal professionals in a demanding international environment.
• Proactive, resourceful, and capable of anticipating needs before they arise.
• Professional, discreet, and confident in managing confidential information.
• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work closely in partnership with another Legal Assistant.
Candidates must already be based in Belgium and have the right to work in Belgium. Visa sponsorship cannot be provided for this position.

Security Cloud Architect | AWS | CISO Office

Are you passionate about securing large-scale cloud environments and driving security by design? We are looking for a Security Cloud Architect to join the CISO Office and play a key role in shaping and governing cloud security across the organisation's cloud transformation journey.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and technical authority on cloud security, helping engineering teams build secure solutions while ensuring security risks are effectively managed. You will define cloud security standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and reusable security patterns, with a strong focus on AWS and exposure to Azure environments.

You will be responsible for reviewing and challenging solution designs, conducting threat modelling and architecture risk assessments, defining remediation plans, and ensuring security controls are aligned with business and regulatory requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, security operations, and risk teams, you will help strengthen cloud security capabilities across the organisation.

We're looking for an experienced cloud security professional with a strong background in AWS security architecture, including IAM, network security, container security (EKS/ECS), DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), cryptography, logging and monitoring, and AWS security services such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, WAF, and KMS.

Key requirements

 
• 10+ years of experience in IT and Cybersecurity

 
• 5+ years of hands-on Cloud Security Architecture experience

 
• Strong expertise in AWS security architecture (Azure is a plus)

 
• Experience defining Cloud Security Control Frameworks and security standards

 
• Proven experience with threat modelling, security assessments, and risk management

 
• Knowledge of NIS2, ISO 27001, CIS, and NIST frameworks

 
• AWS Security Specialty certification is highly desirable

 
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

 
• Fluent English

 

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior cloud security expert who enjoys combining strategic architecture, governance, and hands-on technical security expertise in a modern cloud-first environment.

To find out more about Computer Futures please visit www.computerfutures.com
